ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of the Feeding Our Future Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate the alleged wire fraud and money laundering scheme involving Feeding Our Future and its ringleader Aimee Bock
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to determine the extent of the alleged scheme and identify potential co-conspirators
questions: What was the total amount of money allegedly laundered?
Who else may be involved in the scheme?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraudulent scheme, and by following the money trail, we may be able to identify other individuals or organizations involved
